description: Retrieve district championship qualifying points awarded at an event for each participating team. Returns per-team breakdown of qualification points, alliance selection points, elimination points, and award points (the official FIRST district point system) plus tiebreaker stats (highest qual scores, qual wins). Only meaningful for district-affiliated events; non-district events return null.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.

name: get_event_district_points
